findings.claim: The declared objective is final predicted target affinity as primary, with validity and strain secondary and coordinate control only; the reward view is the endpoint pointcloud with a detached Hungarian endpoint mean-squared-distance and native endpoint VJP, so no affinity-head derivative or extra model forward is available as evidence.

Observed score times span the learning window [0.0,0.5] at 0.01 spacing, and the curve support is [0.0,0.49]; recorded affinities were removed and replaced by an equal score prior, so no absolute affinity target is observable in the supplied evidence.

Continuous contrast features are represented as predicted_endpoint_world_A_features with observed-node linear fits, polynomial fits rejected, and extrapolation disallowed; several landmark features show multiple sign changes and strong sign conflicts across the window, so a constant rule is not supported by these curves.

Landmark_00_soft_mass has a positive first-window rate and a negative last-window rate with four sign changes and one strong sign conflict, indicating a time-conditioned rather than constant contrast behavior within the observed support.

Landmark_00_local_dx and landmark_00_local_dy show large-magnitude first and last rate z-values with opposite signs and multiple sign changes, so their within-window direction is not stable and cannot be treated as a fixed coordinate reward direction.

hypotheses.falsifier: A constant rule with equal or better fit fidelity and no sign-change mismatch across the observed nodes.
hypotheses.observable: landmark_00_soft_mass and landmark_00_local_dx/dy observed-node contrast curves
hypotheses.statement: A time-conditioned contrast rule using validated observed-node interpolation may better match the sign-changing landmark contrast curves than a constant rule over the observed window.

hypotheses.falsifier: Joint diagnostics showing no coupling beyond marginal descriptors.
hypotheses.observable: landmark local second-moment features cxx and cyy
hypotheses.statement: Joint coordinate patterns may carry coupling information not captured by isolated marginal landmark descriptors, but the supplied continuous_trends rows alone do not establish a coherent joint mode.

limitations: No decoded terminal labels or final affinity outcomes are supplied, so last-record or survival credit cannot be presented as final affinity benefit.

task.formula: R=tau*logsumexp(log_pi-rho_delta(q)/tau), q=detached-Hungarian endpoint mean squared distance; rho_delta=delta^2*(sqrt(1+q/delta^2)-1). Actual pointcloud_delta_A defaults to 1 A. Native endpoint VJP, no affinity-head derivative, no extra model forward. teacher_neighbors is a count; temporal_recipe changes only a registered scalar/attention, not velocity. No temperature edits. Inert legacy metadata is not a reward term.

formula_registry.diagnostic_limit: Moment effects, pair kernels and turnover are diagnostic evidence. Executing pointcloud scalar has no pair-kernel, moment, joint-motif or geometry-block term; legacy robust_delta is inert.
formula_registry.dose: Endpoint-VJP force normalized and RMS-scaled against native predictive update; eta/ramp only in U lane.
formula_registry.prior: Detached nearest-k teachers; log_pi=-q_anchor/prior_temperature; scores beta=0; k is a count.
formula_registry.regional: Detached background plus Gaussian landmark attention; positive surrounding weight.
formula_registry.temporal_region: Same static teachers; validated absolute contrast changes regional attention at observed score nodes.
formula_registry.temporal_teacher: (1-blend)*R_static + blend*R_observed_teacher(time); same shared FLOWR endpoint, no velocity target.

incumbent.topology_policy: Free native graph transitions; no pair-distance acceptance or graph equality veto
